predict.question: Building your shelter always costs 2 points. Half the time it pays off with 8 points; otherwise it brings nothing. On average, what is your net gain per build?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Gene effects can extend beyond the organism’s body into its surroundings.
modelBoundary: Omitting construction gives {A}; charging it in both branches gives {B}. An external benefit does not erase the unconditional construction cost.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? These costs and encounters are invented. They do not measure adaptation, inheritance or the fitness of a real structure.
